LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.EndGame.Ending: The Imperial shuttle has carried {STELLARCH_nameDef} and everyone who ascended with {STELLARCH_objective} off this rimworld. From now on, {STELLARCH_pronoun} serves at the right hand of Emperor {EMPEROR_nameFull}.\n\nThe colony remains, and its story goes on.

The nobles will not land while the stellarch is away, the colony is under threat or a landing pad the colony has built cannot be used, and if that lasts a day, the parade is called off.
